model.description: One row per French departement and year, 2000 onward, of GDP at current market prices from Eurostat's regional accounts, in millions of euros, per inhabitant in euros and in purchasing power standards, and per inhabitant relative to France in the same year.
model.name: french_departement_gdp

questions.derivation: Select each departement's GDP per inhabitant in euros, in purchasing power standards and relative to France for a year, keyed by INSEE departement code.
questions.question: How unevenly is GDP per inhabitant spread across the French departements?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar year whose GDP, and GDP per average inhabitant, the row carries.

validations.description: Each departement appears once per year.
validations.name: one_row_per_departement_and_year

validations.description: All 101 declared departements have a row in every year the table covers.

validations.description: Every French NUTS 3 region Eurostat publishes, extra-regio aside, is a declared departement.

validations.description: Departement GDP in euros adds up to French GDP within half a percent.
